paper.title: Revenue: analytical review, FY2025-26 against FY2024-25
paper.objective: Identify revenue lines whose movement against the prior year exceeds the thresholds and obtain explanations.
paper.procedure: Current year compared with prior year by revenue stream; variances above either threshold investigated with management and corroborated.
paper.result: Two streams exceeded the thresholds: export sales (+18.2%) and scrap sales (-31.0%). Explanations obtained and corroborated to shipping records and the scrap contract.
paper.conclusion: Movements are consistent with the business; no further procedures required.
